India Services PMI Reaches 3-Month High in September

India's Services Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) rose to 55.2 in September, marking a three-month high. However, the country's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) growth in the second quarter (Q2) slowed to its lowest point since 2022.
